description: Morphe patches for Hatena Bookmark 5.80 / versionCode 58000 (v0.2.1). Hide native PR/ad entries in the article hot-feed, including cases with no mute words or when signed out. User confirmed successful ad removal on an Android device on 2026-10-17. Includes optional side-by-side clone. APK rebuilding, signing, and compiled DEX were validated; other feeds, login and bookmarking were not separately verified. Source APK is a historical 2024 third-party download and carries security risks.
